name: hbfd_rly_624_ew

job.purpose: native launch re-kit of CLOSED hbfd_rly_624_ew-v1-212c3439c (hbfd_rly_624_EW: TT launch 229.7 ps > 220 on 37 outputs); flop at output pin, HB1 out pad, HB2 in pad; same RTL/outline/pins

pin_regs.reason: ot_hbm_rly IS one register stage by contract (r <= i, o = r): its single flop per bit is the pin register; extra input/output pin registers would make the die relay 3 cycles and break the compiled static schedule. The flop is anchored at the OUTPUT pin (OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE ^o), the input pin keeps its HB2 pad + BUFx4f driver.

reroute_reason.fix: flop anchored at its OUTPUT pin (was at the input face or free): DFFASRHQNx1 QN no longer drives a 10-20 um wire (108 ps clk->QN at 14 fF in NS o[533]); output pad BUF+HB1+BUF instead of BUF+HB4+BUF (-50 ps TT); input HB2 pad; same RTL/outline/pin faces

structural_change: H-DIE-RLY 2026-10-16: native launch FAIL 229.7 ps (37 outputs) of CLOSED hbfd_rly_624_ew-v1-212c3439c. Measured root cause (NS routed STA, o[533]): the single relay flop sat at the INPUT face (io_flop_at_pins anchors i[] first), so DFFASRHQNx1/QN drove a 14 fF cross-tile wire (slew 147 ps, clk->QN 108 ps vs 62 ps at the pin) into INV + BUFx4f + HB4xp67 (68 ps) + BUF + port BUF; the HB4 output stage alone is ~130 ps of every launch (median 208-220 ps). Fix: anchor each flop at its output pin, output pad HB1xp67, input pad HB2xp67 (capture budget 190 has >= 25 ps room), hold margin 10 ps; RTL, outline, pin faces and port list unchanged; 0 cycles.
